title: The Metacognitive Profile Atlas: Domain-level confidence discrimination in 33 frontier LLMs on MMLU
abstract: arXiv:2605.06673v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We release the Metacognitive Profile Atlas, a corpus of answer-plus-verbalized-confidence data from 33 frontier LLMs on 1,500 MMLU items stratified into six subject-group bins (46,157 scored observations after excluding parser-supplied values). The data allow Type-2 AUROC, the degree to which confidence discriminates correct from incorrect answers, to be decomposed by domain. The reliable finding is a population-level ordering on MMLU. Confidence discriminates best on Applied/Professional items (mean AUROC .750; ranked first in 100% of bootstrap resamples) and worst on Formal Reasoning and Natural Science (bottom two in 93% and 92%; Friedman chi^2(5) = 28.26, p < .0001). After Holm correction Applied exceeds Formal, Science, Social and Humanities; no other pair survives, including Applied versus Factual. translated_title: 元认知画像图谱：33个前沿大语言模型在MMLU上的领域级信心辨别能力
translated_abstract: 我们发布了元认知画像图谱，这是一个包含33个前沿大语言模型在1500个MMLU题目上的“答案加言语化信心”数据语料库，题目按六个学科组分层（剔除解析器提供的数值后，共有46,157个有效评分观测）。这些数据使得Type-2 AUROC——即信心区分正确与错误答案的程度——能够按领域进行分解。可靠的发现是MMLU上的群体层面排序：信心辨别能力在应用/专业类题目上表现最好（平均AUROC为0.750；在100%的自助重抽样中排名第一），在形式推理和自然科学类题目上表现最差（分别有93%和92%的重抽样中排名垫底两位；Friedman chi²(5) = 28.26, p < .0001）。经Holm校正后，应用类显著超过形式推理、科学、社会科学和人文类；没有其他配对差异显著，包括应用类与事实类之间的比较。当排除或降低不精确单元格的权重时，该排序依然成立。各模型单独的六领域画像并不可靠（中位数……
tldr: 该研究发布了元认知画像图谱数据集，揭示33个前沿大语言模型的元认知信心辨别能力存在系统性领域差异——在应用/专业类题目上最强，在形式推理和自然科学上最弱，且这一排序在群体层面稳定可靠。
en_tdlr: This study releases the Metacognitive Profile Atlas, a corpus of 46,157 scored observations from 33 frontier LLMs, revealing a reliable population-level ordering in metacognitive confidence discrimination—best on Applied/Professional items and worst on Formal Reasoning and Natural Science domains.
